title: The Pink Gingerbread Hot Cocoa Bar
description: A pink gingerbread hot cocoa bar: gingerbread mugs with gingham bows, pink and white bottle-brush trees, a pink truck with its own tree, an Oh Snap hot cocoa sign and an iridescent glass candy jar.
intro: Okay, confession: I set up a hot cocoa bar "for the kids" and then stood at the kitchen island drinking three mugs myself. The mugs have little gingham bows on the handles, the tiny pink truck hauls its own tree, and the sign literally says Oh Snap. Add a sparkly glass jar of marshmallows and a few bottle-brush trees and the counter goes from cluttered to cute in ten minutes.

sections.heading: The mugs do the heavy lifting
paragraphs: A set of six pink gingerbread mugs, about 4.9 inches tall and 12 ounces each, with pink gingham bows on the handles. Mix the gingerbread men, houses and bows down the counter.

sections.heading: Trees, a truck and a sign
paragraphs: Six pink and white mini bottle-brush trees give the bar height. The little pink metal truck carries its own mini tree, and the 12 by 8 inch Oh Snap hot cocoa and cookie bar sign leans at the back.

sections.heading: Something that sparkles
paragraphs: An iridescent pink glass candy jar with a lid, about 5 inches tall, holds the marshmallows and catches the light.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The rooms, food, furniture and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
